description.value: See Ya Later Ranch is a historic winery and bistro perched high atop Hawthorne Mountain above Okanagan Falls, with roots going back to 1920 when founder Major Hugh Fraser planted the first vines. It is one of the highest-elevation vineyards in the Okanagan Valley and holds the largest planting of Gewürztraminer in North America across 65 acres. Touring cyclists who make the climb are rewarded with award-winning tastings, a valley-view bistro, and a lively events calendar including a Pride celebration.
